nodes.label: Trackall Pollution Trap (one play/swap pollutes balance forever)
nodes.rationale: Casino and PandaPools each use ONE shared covenant address for all users; registering it with `newscript trackall:true` (done only so txnbasics could attach ScriptProofs) made every stranger's coins at that address permanently relevant, polluting the wallet's confirmed/locked balance forever. Fix: register foreign covenants trackall:false — txnbasics reads the script table regardless of the track flag, so transactions still build; own coins stay relevant because core matches wallet keys/addresses against coin HEX state.

nodes.label: Launch Hygiene Sweep (cleanForeign)
nodes.rationale: Demotes tracked covenants whose owner key is provably not this wallet's back to trackall:false and untracks lingering relevant coins. Aborts with zero writes when ownership can't be proven, because a wrong cointrack on an existing coin is permanent — core only re-checks relevance when a block first processes a coin. Re-runs every launch (and after in-app node restart via onNodeRestarted) because core keeps demoted addresses in an in-memory relevance cache until node restart.

nodes.label: Terminal IDE-style Parameter Autocomplete
nodes.rationale: Ported line-for-line from the Terminal IDE APK completion stack (apks/terminalide: CommandRegistry.java, ParamDocs.java, Suggest.java) into renderer/termcomplete.js (engine + 115-command static registry) and generated renderer/termhelp.js (offline node help pages). Static registry replaces the old lazy help-parsed TERM_CMDS list, fixing the never-retry bug when the node was down on first visit.

nodes.label: Wallet.signData Synchronization Fix (bundled jar)
nodes.rationale: The bundled resources/minima.jar ran an unsynchronized read-modify-write of the key `uses` counter in Wallet.signData — the Winternitz one-time-signature reuse documented in minima-core/UPSTREAM_CHANGES.md. signData and updateUses are now both synchronized in the shipped jar (verified by reflection); 0.16.13 carried the fix forward onto upstream node 1.1.2.4.

nodes.label: In-app Node Jar Updater Removal
nodes.rationale: The updater pointed at a private repo with no releases so it could never work, and jarPath() preferred an updater-downloaded userData copy over the bundled jar — anyone who ever ran it would boot a stale jar forever and never receive the signData security fix. The shipped jar is now the only jar the app runs; stale userData copies are ignored, not deleted.

nodes.label: PandaPools Owner-Key Hunt Ledger (bounded, kidx backup v3)
nodes.rationale: A persistent per-(seed, opk) ledger caps lifetime key mints at 256, charged per real mint only. `kidx` (owner key derivation index) added to recipes and backup format v3 makes hunts exact and lets a wallet already past the index prove a foreign seed with zero mints. Also fixed a late-spend hazard where the serial hunt gate could fire a real spend after the caller's UI timeout.

nodes.label: AtomiX Serial Signing Gate + Unique Txn Ids
nodes.rationale: Only one signing command in flight at a time so the node can't issue the same one-time key leaf for two different messages; millisecond-granular txn ids gained a monotonic counter so two settlement actions in the same millisecond no longer merge into one node-side transaction.

nodes.label: Owner Key Signature Count Through Backup/Restore (opkuses, format v2)
nodes.rationale: A pool owner key is minted with newaddress, so a seed-only re-sync re-mints it at uses=0 and the next owner action re-signs already-spent Winternitz leaves, leaking the private key. Backup format v2 carries opkuses + atblock; restore winds each regenerated key forward to count + elapsed blocks / 900 + slack by burning leaves via `sign`, needing no forked node.

nodes.label: PandaPools Persistent History + Per-Pool Statement
nodes.rationale: txpowid-keyed history mirror (pp_history); routed swaps split across the pools actually touched and checked against the wallet's own movement — untied rows are flagged and excluded rather than mis-booked. History pages at 512 here because the 256 KB reply cap lives in the Android broadcast receiver, not the node's HTTP RPC; set via the MDS shim (historyPageMax) so engine files stay byte-identical.

nodes.label: Balances Full Breakdown + Untruncated Tagged Coin List
nodes.rationale: Every balance figure (confirmed, locked, unconfirmed) shows unconditionally, zeros included, so committed funds are accounted for. The coin list dropped its 50-coin cap and shows full coinids because it is an audit view — an elided id can't be looked up. Coins gain pool/beacon tags resolved from the live PandaPools engine so the confirmed-vs-spendable gap is named.

nodes.label: Winternitz One-Time-Signature Reuse Hazard
nodes.rationale: Signing one Winternitz (WOTS) leaf twice leaks its private key. This single hazard drives the Wallet.signData synchronization, the AtomiX serial signing gate, the opkuses backup format, the owner-key hunt ledger, and the per-address key-uses safety checker (0.7.1).

nodes.label: Byte-Identical MDS Engine Reuse Rule
nodes.rationale: Desktop module tabs (PandaPools, AtomiX, Casino, miniMall, Vestr) reuse the MiniDapp engine files byte-identical / verbatim; desktop-specific behaviour is injected only through the MDS shim (e.g. historyPageMax) or wrapper code, keeping mirror discipline with the native and MDS peers.

nodes.label: ETH Wallet Tab
nodes.rationale: Standalone ERC20 wallet on the same seed-derived address AtomiX uses, reusing AtomiX's ETH engine (no new crypto). 0.16.1 hardened it after a fund-safety review: fee-tier floor, hostile-RPC gas-drain clamp, duplicate-send lock, broadcast-ambiguity handling, EIP-55 checksum, token-file DoS.

nodes.label: Web Wallet Tab
nodes.rationale: Local MegaMMR-gated wallet-from-seed, keys stay on-device. Deliberately shows `confirmed` (not sendable) because a foreign megammr seed reports sendable:0 — the opposite display choice from the main Balances tab, kept on purpose.

nodes.label: ZeroEdge Casino Tab (P2PChance)
nodes.rationale: Removed as a visible tab in 0.11.1 (code preserved), later gated behind a Settings 18+ self-certification (CFG.casinoEnabled). 0.16.19 fixed its trackall pollution trap and a donor keys-parse bug where a bare-array `keys` response resolved res.response.keys to Array.prototype.keys, silently parsing zero keys.
